evidence_class: kernel sweep; this establishes nothing about model quality
dispatch_base: cd87939 per latest dispatch; embedded order says 62a982e; not git-verified; no git used

quantizer.note: dequantized floating Kq, no packed INT4/INT8 kernels; GQA shares each KV head rotation

eq_rule.query_rows: floor(linspace(0,L-1,min(32,L))) includes first and last; decode uses its one full row
eq_rule.distribution: independent standard-normal fp32 q,K; all S keys; existing GPU TurboQuant quantizer; exact target FP64 dot of FP32 inputs times the actual FP32 scale, diagnostic bulk in kernel FMA/shuffle order
eq_rule.freeze: all 64 bit/shape measurements required; create-only e_q_table.json plus sha256 before any G3 use; later changes require separate amendment/table identity
eq_rule.validity: finite calibration maximum, NOT universal bound; G3 checks all held-out logits for exceedances without retuning; breach marks conditional guarantee RED but raw curve remains reported

baseline.path: existing dequantized-K two-pass auto dispatch; same Kq as SP

sweep.timing: interleaved old/SP pairs, order alternates; CUDA events plus wall latency; diagnostics and quantization excluded for both
sweep.dense_timing: omitted to bound resource use; full dense fp32 output deviation mandatory
sweep.fraction: GPU SP selected mask; baseline diagnostic recomputes exact same CUDA stats and dot order, gated against actual baseline output

gates.SP_mask: exact vs CUDA diagnostic bulk prefix/partition rule
gates.baseline: actual kernel vs materialized CUDA diagnostic decisions, unchanged tolerance

sweep.crossings: grid traversed descending epsilon; first strict relative-Frobenius improvement; also first max-abs improvement separately; first speed<1.0. NOT_OBSERVED only with complete grid; otherwise BLOCKED_INCOMPLETE; nonmonotonicity reported
sweep.per_invocation: one measurement class or one bit/shape/epsilon sweep row; resume executes one then returns

predictions.P1: e_q at 2 bits on D=128 >=0.05 scaled-logit units
predictions.P2: at epsilon=1e-3 SP fraction strictly below z on causal long-S (prefill8192,decode32768), strictly above on noncausal short-S (prefill2048,decode8192); all relevant bit/shape rows; causal label alone does not establish peakedness
predictions.P3: at each grid epsilon <=1e-2, SP relative-Frobenius deviation strictly below baseline on >=75% of 64 bit/shape classes; max-abs scored separately
predictions.P4: all prefill8192/decode32768 rows at grid epsilons>=1e-3 have speed>=1.0 vs baseline

G1.monotone: prefix extension, random ordered partitions, epsilon nesting
G1.entry_parity: host scalar real extension + CPU emulators for both paths; actual device parity additionally G3
